segment_contamination_dimensions: Non-residential single-occupant temporary shelter buyers (guard huts, bunkhouses, site offices) — siblings such as Guard Huts, Bunkhouses, MS Bunkhouse, Prefab Steel Bunk House, Bunk House Office, and PVC Guard Huts serve buyers seeking minimal temporary enclosures, not habitable residential or hospitality units; names implying guard, bunk, hut, or temporary site shelter are blocked to prevent attracting this incompatible buyer segment.

Timber, bamboo, and log construction buyers — siblings Log Homes, Wooden House, Prefabricated Wooden House, Log Cabin, and Bamboo Huts attract buyers specifically seeking natural-material structures; any name foregrounding wood, timber, bamboo, or log construction is blocked as it misrepresents the steel/MS container material identity of this MCAT.

Generic prefabricated house buyers without container-specific intent — sibling Prefabricated Houses (ID 35591) is the broad parent category; names that omit 'container' or 'shipping container' and read as generic prefab housing are blocked to prevent this MCAT from being indistinguishable from the parent, ensuring buyers with container-specific intent are correctly routed.

Portable/temporary structure buyers seeking non-residential mobility — siblings Portable House, Mild Steel Portable House, and Portable Huts attract buyers prioritising relocatability over habitability; names emphasising portability alone without residential context are blocked to avoid attracting buyers who do not intend permanent or semi-permanent residential use.
